title: Prediction-Powered LLM Ranking with Adaptively Collected Human Feedback
abstract: arXiv:2611.13186v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ranking large language models (LLMs) through human evaluations is essential for downstream decision-making. Because human feedback is expensive, evaluation platforms often collect it adaptively, prioritizing informative model comparisons using previously observed feedback. To further improve precision with limited human feedback, evaluators can draw on abundant unrated responses and relatively inexpensive LLM judges; however, judge bias and adaptive dependence challenge standard i.i.d. inference frameworks. We propose Prediction-Powered Ranking (PP-Rank), a framework that combines LLM-judge predictions with human feedback to improve precision while providing valid inference under adaptive sampling. Data-driven prediction weights minimize the asymptotic covariance trace within the proposed class. In theory, we establish asymptotic normality for general evaluation targets and simultaneous ranking inference. A joint martingale analysis hand

translated_title: 基于自适应收集人类反馈的预测驱动大语言模型排名
translated_abstract: 通过人类评估对大型语言模型（LLM）进行排名对于下游决策至关重要。由于人类反馈成本高昂，评估平台通常采用自适应方式收集反馈，即利用先前观察到的反馈来优先进行信息量更大的模型比较。为了在有限的人类反馈下进一步提高评估精度，评估者可以利用大量未评分的响应以及相对廉价的LLM评判者；然而，评判者偏差和自适应数据依赖性对标准的独立同分布（i.i.d.）推断框架构成了挑战。我们提出了预测驱动排名框架（Prediction-Powered Ranking, PP-Rank），该框架将LLM评判者的预测与人类反馈相结合，在自适应采样下既能提高精度又能提供有效推断。数据驱动的预测权重在所提出的权重类别中最小化渐近协方差迹。在理论方面，我们针对一般评估目标和同时排名推断建立了渐近正态性，并通过联合鞅分析（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出PP-Rank框架，通过将廉价的LLM评判者预测与自适应收集的人类反馈相结合，在自适应采样下实现有效统计推断，显著提升大语言模型排名评估的精度。
en_tdlr: Proposes PP-Rank, a prediction-powered ranking framework that combines inexpensive LLM-judge predictions with adaptively collected human feedback to improve ranking precision while ensuring valid inference under adaptive sampling.
